# NOLA Restaurant

> Restaurant in San Antonio, Texas. New Orleans comfort food: blue crab omelets, shrimp and grits, boudin balls and fresh beignets.

- Phone: (210) 255-8842
- Address: 1101 Broadway Ste 120, San Antonio, TX 78215
- Areas: San Antonio, Converse, Schertz, Boerne, New Braunfels
- Offers: Beignets, all day; Brunch plates; Po'boys and Creole plates
- Rating: 4.4 from 3127 Google reviews
